title.narrative: Strengthening Information Integrity through MIL in the Digital Ecosystem

description.narrative: UNESCO will strengthen information integrity in digital and media environments through Media and Information Literacy (MIL) initiatives targeting key actors in the digital information ecosystem, particularly digital content creators and regulators. The project will support these stakeholders in strengthening and applying MIL competencies to promote critical thinking, ethical communication practices and content creation as well as informed participation in digital spaces. The project will focus on two mutually reinforcing areas: 1. Empowering digital content creators and influencers through MIL to strengthen ethical content production, ethical use of digital technologies and AI, verification practices, and audience trust; and 2. Advancing MIL in digital platform governance discussions by supporting regulators and relevant stakeholders in integrating user empowerment, critical thinking and human-rights-based approaches into digital governance frameworks as well as the protection of children in digital environments. Through capacity-building, research, policy dialogue, partnerships and knowledge-sharing initiatives, UNESCO will promote more trustworthy, inclusive and human-centred digital information environments. Particular attention will be given to strengthening resilience to misinformation, disinformation, online hate speech and online gender-based violence, while promoting freedom of expression and inclusive participation in digital spaces.
